description: This Java source file defines the CatalogUrlFilter class, which implements a servlet Filter for handling URL rewriting and routing in an e-commerce catalog application. It processes URL paths to identify product and category identifiers, constructs appropriate internal URLs, manages category trails, and forwards requests accordingly.

classes.name: CatalogUrlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class that intercepts HTTP requests to process URL rewriting for product and category pages, managing URL parameters, category trails, and request forwarding within an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main method that processes incoming HTTP requests, parses URL paths to identify product or category identifiers, constructs internal URLs, manages category trails, and forwards requests accordingly.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is taken out of service.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Constructs a category URL based on request parameters, either from an alternative URL or by generating a URL from category trail data.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Overloaded method that builds a category URL using detailed parameters, including URL trail, product/category IDs, view options, and search strings.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Creates a product URL from request context and product identifiers, utilizing content wrappers and category trails.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Overloaded method that constructs a product URL from a product content wrapper, trail, and URL parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultLocaleString
methods.description: Returns the default locale string used for URL processing.

methods.name: setDefaultLocaleString
methods.description: Sets the default locale string used for URL processing.

methods.name: setRedirectUrl
methods.description: Sets the redirect URL used for URL rewriting.
